coincidence_screen.interpretation: Coincidence density is exploratory. Repeated passage lengths and construction constraints can create spectral coincidences without deliberate acoustic tuning.

uncertainty.dimension_measurement_uncertainty: Use published uncertainty where available; unresolved chamber uncertainties are not replaced by zero.

human_summary.headline: Known Khafre interior screening predicts 354 analytical modes below 150 Hz across 12 components.
human_summary.first_pass_interpretation: The geometry produces multiple low-frequency mode families and several near-coincidences. This is expected for coupled chambers/passages; controls are required before any tuning claim.

interpretation_guard: Resonance is normal physical behavior. This screening result is not evidence of intentional acoustic design and does not promote any archaeological interpretation.
